Subject: Renewal: proposal to double dedicated pool (8→16 GPUs) & amended monthly commit

Hi Elena,

As we approach your renewal on 2026-12-01, I wanted to put a concrete proposal on the table that aligns with the increased demand you outlined in last week's call. Helio's sustained peak has moved from the 8-GPU profile to steady-state loads we expect to be best served by a 16-GPU reserved pool.

What we're proposing: 
- Scale dedicated pool from 8 → 16 GPUs (same instance types).
- New monthly committed spend: $76,000 (up from $41,500) — committed capacity pricing with a 12-month term.
- Throughput target: baseline guaranteed capacity to support 2x concurrent inference streams w/ 99.95% uptime SLA and automatic regional failover.
- Ramp: full capacity active on day 1 of the new term; we can optionally tier the billing with a 6-week ramp credit if you prefer.

Attached is an amendment draft and a short capacity runbook that outlines how we’ll migrate traffic without downtime. Can we set a 30-minute slot tomorrow for legal/procurement to review? If procurement wants a PO first, we can accept that and route the amendment for signature via DocuSign.

Next steps I recommend: 
1) Quick internal review of the attached amendment.
2) Procurement confirms PO or redline requests.
3) Sign amendment and schedule the capacity activation window.

Thanks — happy to walk through the pricing/SLAs live.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround. Answers inline and attaching a marked-up amendment and a short test summary: 

- Throughput & tests: We ran Helio-like workload A (batch size 1–4, sequence length median 256) on 8 vs 16 GPUs. Observed sustained median per-GPU throughput of ~420 tokens/sec and p95 of ~620 tokens/sec. For the 16-GPU pool you should expect aggregate sustained throughput ~6,700–7,200 tokens/sec with headroom for spikes; that maps to the “2x concurrent” experience you saw in staging. The test-summary doc is in the runbook.
- SLA credits: SLA is 99.95% with a tiered credit schedule: 10% of monthly committed spend for a single-month breach below 99.95, escalating to 30% for repeated breaches per quarter. We can drop the detailed table into the amendment.
- Pricing: $76,000 is the committed monthly charge for 12 months. Overage rate (if you exceed the reserved capacity) is billed at $0.045/token-equivalent (usage tier); we included example overage scenarios in the runbook.

We can include a one-month migration credit at 10% as a gesture — Marissa and Connor are cc'd to confirm approvals and finance impact.

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-amendment-draft-v2.pdf (updated), capacity-runbook-helio.xlsx (test-summary tab)

Would you like us to route the amended doc to DocuSign or send a clean PDF to procurement first?

Best,
Rishi
